book.name: Madiyu
book.title: To Nafa We Madiyu E Sa꞉sa꞉lo꞉

content: Yo꞉n ho꞉n amilo꞉ to꞉lola꞉sen e sana sowo꞉
Ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉ Ga꞉lili hen o꞉lo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉lowan kalu Ha꞉lod e, Ya꞉su elo꞉ nanogo꞉ halaido꞉ dimida꞉lab malolo꞉ a꞉no꞉ dabu.

Ha꞉lod eyo꞉ ene nanogdo꞉ dia꞉sen kalumo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Kalu we Yo꞉n, ho꞉n amilo꞉ to꞉lola꞉leno꞉ o꞉m. E sowa꞉sa꞉ga꞉, nolba꞉yo꞉ e a꞉ma꞉la꞉ dasi alifa꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, o꞉go꞉ molo ha꞉na꞉no꞉lo꞉ dimidama꞉no꞉ halaido꞉ alano꞉ e amio꞉ da꞉lab.” Ha꞉lod eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉.

Tamin amio꞉, Ha꞉lod eyo꞉ ene ao Filiba꞉ inga Ha꞉lodias, e asulia꞉ga꞉ a꞉diabiki, Yo꞉na꞉yo꞉, “Gilo꞉ dimidab wema꞉yo꞉ ele saefa꞉yo꞉ o꞉go꞉sab.” A꞉la꞉sa꞉labikiyo꞉ Ha꞉lod eyo꞉ Yo꞉no꞉ ta꞉lia꞉sa꞉ga꞉ dibolowa to꞉lo alifa꞉.
Ha꞉lod eyo꞉ Yo꞉no꞉ sana soma꞉no꞉ asulo꞉ ko꞉sega, kaluka꞉isale iliyo꞉ Yo꞉n e dinali sa꞉lan kalulo꞉b a꞉la꞉tili asulo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, Ha꞉lod eyo꞉ Yo꞉no꞉ sana soma꞉no꞉wo꞉ tagilabiki, ka ta꞉fo꞉.

Ko꞉sega Ha꞉lodo꞉ sa꞉la꞉li ho꞉leno꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowabiki, ma꞉no꞉ alan sagalaki na꞉liki sen amio꞉, Ha꞉lodiasa꞉ ida꞉ a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ momada꞉sa꞉ga꞉, kalu kegeo꞉ us a꞉namio꞉ gulo꞉ gulabiki, Ha꞉lod e sagalo꞉ alan dowo꞉. A꞉la꞉go꞉ko꞉lo꞉ Ha꞉lod eyo꞉ Godeya꞉ siwa꞉l amio꞉ a꞉la꞉dinali saefa꞉, “Giyo꞉ nemo꞉wo꞉ kelego꞉ o꞉ba꞉le dabu ba꞉dalega, go꞉ndo꞉ sa꞉lab aumbo꞉ dimia꞉nigo꞉l,” a꞉la꞉sio꞉.
Ha꞉lodias eyo꞉ ida꞉mo꞉wo꞉ asulo꞉wo꞉ dimi ko꞉lo꞉, ida꞉ a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ Ha꞉lodbo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Yo꞉na꞉ misa꞉yo꞉ gedea꞉sa꞉ga꞉ go꞉fo꞉ wa꞉la dia꞉ta꞉ga꞉ nemo꞉ dimia꞉bi,” a꞉la꞉sio꞉

Misa꞉ kalu alan Ha꞉lod e to sa꞉lab a꞉no꞉ da꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, e kele asulaki nofolo꞉wo꞉ alan dowo꞉. Ko꞉sega eyo꞉ kalu ma꞉no꞉lo꞉ ma꞉ni mio꞉ a꞉ma꞉ si wa꞉l amio꞉ dinali saefa꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, eyo꞉ ene nanog kaluwa꞉yo꞉ misa꞉yo꞉ ga o꞉mo꞉ dimina꞉ki towo꞉ halaido꞉ sio꞉.
Eyo꞉ Yo꞉na꞉ dagaso꞉ gedema꞉ki ene nanog kaluwo꞉ dibolo aya iliga꞉fo꞉
A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ Yo꞉na꞉ misa꞉yo꞉ gedelea꞉sa꞉ga꞉, go꞉fo꞉ wa꞉la dia꞉ta꞉ga꞉, ga o꞉mo꞉ dimiabikiyo꞉, eyo꞉ dia꞉sa꞉ga꞉ anomo꞉ dimi.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Yo꞉na꞉lo꞉ tili wida꞉sen kalu iyo꞉ ya꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Yo꞉na꞉ do꞉mo꞉wo꞉ dia꞉ha꞉na꞉sa꞉ga꞉ dali alitakiyo꞉, iyo꞉ ha꞉na꞉sa꞉ga꞉ Ya꞉sumo꞉ sa꞉ma꞉ni ane.
Ya꞉su eyo꞉ kaluwo꞉ daosen bila꞉fo꞉mo꞉wo꞉ ma꞉no꞉wo꞉ dimi

Ya꞉su e Yo꞉no꞉ sana sowo꞉ka꞉ a꞉la꞉do꞉ sa꞉lab a꞉no꞉ da꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, e hen a꞉no꞉ ta꞉ta꞉sa꞉ga꞉, e ina꞉li o꞉dofa꞉no꞉ a꞉laki, ho꞉n ko꞉suwa disa꞉ta꞉ga꞉, kalulo꞉ma hen a꞉na ha꞉na꞉ni ane. Ko꞉sega kaluka꞉isale amisa꞉n a꞉namilo꞉ kandayo꞉ a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ elo꞉ dimido꞉ a꞉no꞉ da꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, iyo꞉ ho꞉n golo꞉ aniba ha꞉nakiyo꞉, Ya꞉suwo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ galima꞉ni ha꞉na꞉ni ane.

Ya꞉suwo꞉ ho꞉n ko꞉suwa ha꞉na꞉ga꞉yo꞉, ha꞉la꞉ya sili alita꞉ga꞉ ba꞉ba꞉ amio꞉, kaluka꞉isale modo꞉ kegenefo꞉lena ba꞉ba꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, eyo꞉ i a꞉no꞉ alan nofolaki, i amilo꞉ kaluka꞉isale walafdo꞉ dosdo꞉ a꞉no꞉ tambo falele alifelo꞉.

Ga꞉lo dowabiki, Ya꞉suwa꞉lo꞉ tili wida꞉sen kaluwo꞉ elo꞉wa ya꞉sa꞉ga꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Hen we ma꞉no꞉lo꞉ dia꞉no꞉wo꞉ aundo꞉ma, a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ga꞉lo dowabo꞉lo꞉biki, giyo꞉ kaluka꞉isale kegeo꞉ we ma꞉no꞉ ma꞉no꞉wo꞉ ini kililima꞉ki, amisa꞉na iliga꞉felema,” a꞉la꞉sio꞉.
Ya꞉su eyo꞉ imo꞉wo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉bo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Kaluka꞉isale kegeo꞉ we a꞉ma꞉la꞉bo꞉ waga iliga꞉fa꞉no꞉wo꞉? Ma꞉no꞉ ma꞉no꞉wo꞉ gili dimina.”
A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, iyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Niliyo꞉ falawa dowo꞉fa꞉yo꞉ bila꞉fo꞉, a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ka꞉ a꞉la꞉ a꞉no꞉ko꞉ da꞉lab,” a꞉la꞉sio꞉.
“A꞉no꞉ nelo꞉ wena dia꞉mena.” Ya꞉su eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉.

Ya꞉su eyo꞉ kaluka꞉isaleyo꞉ fugusa꞉ wa꞉la kandama꞉ki sa꞉la꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, falawa dowo꞉fa꞉ bila꞉fo꞉ o꞉lia꞉ ka꞉ a꞉la꞉ dia꞉sa꞉ga꞉, akino꞉ alolo bo꞉fo꞉liki, Godemo꞉ mada o꞉m a꞉la꞉dulugu sio꞉. A꞉la꞉sa꞉la꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉ eyo꞉ falawa dowo꞉fa꞉ a꞉no꞉ a꞉na goda꞉sa꞉ga꞉, ene tiliwida꞉sen kalumo꞉ dimiabiki, iliyo꞉ kaluka꞉isalemo꞉wo꞉ a꞉na so꞉go꞉.
Kaluka꞉isale kegeo꞉ a꞉no꞉ tambo ma꞉no꞉wo꞉ o꞉li na꞉sa꞉ga꞉ ililitabiki, ma꞉no꞉ heb ta꞉felab a꞉no꞉ enedo꞉ tili wida꞉sen kalu iliyo꞉ kegeo꞉ amio꞉ fafowo꞉ kugula꞉fo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ wa꞉litabi difa꞉.
Ma꞉no꞉ o꞉lo꞉ mo꞉no꞉, kalule agelo꞉wo꞉ daosen bila꞉fo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ sen (5,000.) Ko꞉sega ka꞉isale o꞉lia꞉ so꞉wagalin o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ mo꞉agelo꞉.
Ya꞉suwo꞉ ho꞉n fa꞉sa꞉ wa꞉la wa꞉la꞉la꞉i mio꞉

O꞉g a꞉nakabiyo꞉ Ya꞉su eyo꞉ enedo꞉ tili wida꞉sen kalu a꞉no꞉ ko꞉suwa disa꞉la꞉sa꞉ga꞉, ho꞉n golo꞉ nodowa tamina hamana꞉kiyo꞉, imo꞉wo꞉ halale sio꞉. Iyo꞉ iliga꞉takiyo꞉, Ya꞉su eyo꞉ kaluka꞉isale kegeo꞉ a꞉no꞉lo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉ iliga꞉felo꞉.
Iyo꞉ iliga꞉takiyo꞉ ina꞉li misio꞉wa fa꞉la꞉ ha꞉na꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Godemo꞉ dulugu sa꞉ma꞉ni ane. Sola꞉ga꞉ yabikiyo꞉ e ina꞉li ka elen.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ho꞉n ko꞉suwo꞉ ho꞉n sa꞉ a꞉no꞉ ta꞉ta꞉sa꞉ga꞉ aneyo꞉, ho꞉n golo꞉ usa dowabikiyo꞉, fufayo꞉ alan ilo꞉ ha꞉na꞉no꞉ doba꞉da꞉ a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ yakiyo꞉, ma꞉feyo꞉ alan a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ iyo꞉ nodoma꞉no꞉ dowo꞉.
Ho꞉lema꞉no꞉wo꞉ ko꞉na꞉ma dowabikiyo꞉, Ya꞉suwo꞉ ho꞉n fa꞉sa꞉ wa꞉la wa꞉la꞉la꞉li ha꞉na꞉ga꞉, ilo꞉wa fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉
Tiliwida꞉sen kaluwa꞉yo꞉ Ya꞉suwo꞉ ho꞉na꞉ wa꞉la yabiki ba꞉ba꞉ amio꞉, iyo꞉ mada iligo꞉. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ iyo꞉ tagilaki a꞉la꞉ho꞉le sio꞉, “Sowo꞉ mama ko꞉lo꞉ yabolo꞉ka꞉!”
A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, Ya꞉su eyo꞉ towo꞉ imo꞉wo꞉ bo꞉bo꞉ge sio꞉, “Gio꞉ tagila꞉so꞉bo. We neka꞉! Gili asulo꞉wo꞉ halale doma,” a꞉la꞉sio꞉.
Bidaya꞉ sa꞉lakiyo꞉, “Kalu Alan hendele gelalega, ne gelo꞉ amio꞉ ho꞉na꞉ wa꞉la menalema,” a꞉la꞉sio꞉.
Ya꞉su eyo꞉ “Ge mena!” a꞉la꞉sio꞉. A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ Bida e ko꞉suwa a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ho꞉na꞉ wa꞉la tibo꞉lota꞉ga꞉, Ya꞉sulo꞉wa ane.
Ko꞉sega Bida e fufa alan a꞉no꞉ ba꞉dakiyo꞉ e tagi dowo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, e ho꞉n amio꞉ mo꞉mo꞉da tinabikiyo꞉, Ya꞉suwo꞉ ho꞉idaki a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Kalu Alan, ne gasilima.”
Wigibo a꞉naka Ya꞉su eyo꞉ Bidayo꞉ gasiliakiyo꞉, “Gi tilidabuwo꞉ ha꞉lulo꞉b. Ge asulo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉ dowabko꞉ mo꞉wo꞉ ha꞉?” Ya꞉su eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ a꞉la꞉yo꞉ ko꞉suwa a꞉disa꞉tabiki, fufa ya꞉len a꞉no꞉ a꞉na bulufo꞉.
Kalu ko꞉su amilo꞉ sen i a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ Ya꞉su e wabudaki a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ge mada hendele Godeya꞉ So꞉walelo꞉ka꞉,” a꞉la꞉sio꞉.
Ya꞉su eyo꞉ Genesalet kaluka꞉isaleyo꞉ falele alifelo꞉
Iyo꞉ ho꞉n golo꞉ nodowa ta꞉nota꞉ga꞉yo꞉, Genesalet hen a꞉na fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉.

Genesalet amisa꞉n kalu iliyo꞉ Ya꞉suwo꞉ fanda ba꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, towo꞉ amisa꞉n ta꞉i ane o꞉mo꞉wo꞉ tambo saga꞉felo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, walaf kaluka꞉isale amisa꞉n a꞉namida꞉lo꞉ sab a꞉no꞉ tambo Ya꞉sulo꞉wa tililia꞉ ya꞉sio꞉.

Kaluka꞉isale iliyo꞉ Ya꞉sumo꞉ susiakiyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ni walaf kalu wema꞉yo꞉ gi helebeso꞉g migif kona goma꞉no꞉wo꞉ o꞉liya꞉le?” A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ walaf kaluka꞉isale abeyo꞉ ene so꞉g amilo꞉ golab a꞉no꞉, e falelab.
